display.purpose: Couple names on the hero — the largest, most emotionally weighted text.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, descriptions, form text. Optimized for mobile reading.

label.purpose: Category headers, countdown units, FAQ question labels. Always uppercase with wide tracking.

motion.name: reveal-in
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal fade-in with 8px upward translate. One-shot, triggered by IntersectionObserver.

motion.name: stagger-in
motion.purpose: Staggered entry for grouped items (hero stack, FAQ rows, timeline entries). Delay steps are 120-200ms.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.value: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease
motion.purpose: Subtle color transitions on button hovers, toggle states, and input focus.

decorationMeta.purpose: Floral PNGs anchored to section corners as a decorative frame. Assets live in public/decor/.

fitModes.name: corner
fitModes.value: width-scaled, art hugs the corner in L

fitModes.name: side
fitModes.value: full-height, art hugs the horizontal edge; the transparent canvas overflow is clipped

decorationMeta.depthOrder: decoration z-0 -> photo z-10 -> text z-20

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sole CTA button. Bronze fill, ivory text, minimal radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); color: var(--color-ivory, #FFFFFF); padding: 12px 32px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-btn-primary { font-size: 1.125rem; } } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(181, 126, 127, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy, #000040); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Toggle Button
components.description: Binary choice button used in the RSVP form. Bronze fill when selected, outlined when not.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-toggle { padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1.125rem; border: 1px solid rgba(19,19,19,0.2); background: var(--color-ivory, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-ink, #131313); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); color: var(--color-ivory, #FFFFFF); border-color: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); } .ds-toggle:hover { border-color: rgba(19,19,19,0.4); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy, #000040); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field with ivory background, subtle border, bronze focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: rgba(19,19,19,0.7); } .ds-input { background: var(--color-ivory, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-ink, #131313); border: 1px solid rgba(19,19,19,0.2); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1.125rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy, #000040); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Split Section
components.description: Asymmetric two-column layout: 65/35 or 35/65 image-text split. Stacks vertically on mobile, image on top.
components.html:
Te invitamos a ser parte

Hoy queremos celebrar con quienes más queremos.
components.css: .ds-split { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 100dvh; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 65fr 35fr; } } .ds-split-text { position: relative; z-index: 20; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 48px 32px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-split-text { order: 2; height: 50dvh; padding: 24px; } } .ds-split-heading { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 2.25rem; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-split-heading { font-size: 3rem; } } .ds-split-body { margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(19,19,19,0.7); } .ds-split-image { position: relative; z-index: 10; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(19,19,19,0.08); } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-split-image { order: 1; height: 50dvh; } }

components.name: Countdown
components.description: Four-cell numeric countdown. Serif numerals, uppercase sans labels.
components.html:
128días
04horas
27min
09seg
components.css: .ds-countdown { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-countdown { gap: 24px; } } .ds-countdown-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-countdown-num { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 2.25rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-countdown-num { font-size: 3rem; } } .ds-countdown-label { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: rgba(19,19,19,0.55); }

components.name: FAQ Accordion
components.description: Single-open accordion. Bronze uppercase trigger with a plus that rotates into a cross; content expands on a grid-rows transition.
components.html:
Elegante. Evitar color blanco o beige.

La ceremonia empieza a las 16:00. Llegar 10 minutos antes.
components.css: .ds-faq { width: 300px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-faq { width: 400px; } } .ds-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(19,19,19,0.1); } .ds-faq-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; background: none; border: none; text-align: left; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); cursor: pointer; } .ds-faq-icon { font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1; color: rgba(19,19,19,0.4); transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-faq-item--open .ds-faq-icon { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq-content { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; transition: grid-template-rows 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-faq-item--open .ds-faq-content { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-faq-inner { overflow: hidden; min-height: 0; } .ds-faq-answer { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 16px; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(19,19,19,0.7); } .ds-faq-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy, #000040); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Vertical schedule spine with bronze dots, uppercase bronze time labels and serif titles. Staggered entry.
components.html:
16:00

Ceremonia

Nos damos el sí en el predio.

17:00

Fotos y brindis

Fotos grupales y primer brindis al aire libre.
components.css: .ds-timeline { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 400px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-timeline-spine { position: absolute; top: 24px; bottom: 24px; left: 5px; width: 1px; background: rgba(19,19,19,0.15); } .ds-timeline-item { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 16px; padding-left: 24px; padding-bottom: 32px; text-align: left; } .ds-timeline-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; } .ds-timeline-dot { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); } .ds-timeline-time { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); } .ds-timeline-title { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); } .ds-timeline-desc { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(19,19,19,0.7); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-timeline-desc { font-size: 1rem; } }

components.name: Scroll Dots
components.description: Fixed section navigation. A hairline track with a bronze progress fill, one dot per section, labels revealed on hover. Active dot is bronze and larger.
components.css: .ds-dots { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-dots-track { position: absolute; top: 14px; bottom: 14px; left: 50%; width: 1px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: rgba(19,19,19,0.1); } .ds-dots-progress { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 50%; width: 1px; height: calc((100% - 28px) * 0.2); transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); transition: height 0.5s ease-out; } .ds-dots-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; } .ds-dots-dot { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(19,19,19,0.25); background: var(--color-cream, #DFD1CC); transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-dots-dot--active { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-color: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); background: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); } .ds-dots-row:hover .ds-dots-dot { transform: scale(1.25); border-color: rgba(19,19,19,0.5); }

components.name: Section Decoration
components.description: Transparent floral PNGs anchored to section corners as a frame. Assets live in public/decor/ (rose-top-left, rose-bottom-right, cherry-top-right, cherry-bottom-left). Decoration always sits below photos and text.
components.css: .ds-decor { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 220px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-cream, #DFD1CC); } .ds-decor-content { position: relative; z-index: 20; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 1.75rem; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); } .ds-decor-corner { pointer-events: none; user-select: none; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 0; width: 52%; max-width: 200px; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background-image: url('/decor/rose-top-left.png'); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: top left; background-size: contain; } .ds-decor-side { pointer-events: none; user-select: none; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: 0; z-index: 0; width: 60%; background-image: url('/decor/cherry-top-right.png'); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: right center; background-size: contain; }

narrative.overview: A restrained, warm visual world built on cream and bronze. The system prioritizes clarity and ceremony over decoration: full-viewport scroll-snap sections create a page-by-page reading rhythm, serif headings carry emotional weight while sans-serif body text stays effortlessly legible. Every element earns its place — no ornamental borders beyond the documented section decorations, no gradient washes, no hover theatrics beyond a subtle opacity shift.
keyCharacteristics: Cream background with bronze accent on a strict two-color-plus-neutrals palette
Full-viewport scroll-snap sections as the primary spatial model
Serif/sans pairing (Cormorant Garamond + Jost) for display/body hierarchy
Minimal elevation — flat surfaces, no shadows, depth through image cropping, split layouts, and the documented section decorations

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Bronze is the only chromatic accent on any screen. It is used on CTAs, active states, and a handful of label treatments — never more than ~15% of visible area.

rules.name: The Navy-is-for-Focus Rule
rules.body: Navy appears only as a :focus-visible outline. It is not a text color, background, or decorative element.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Letter-Spacing Rule
rules.body: Labels and category headers use uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-[0.3em]. This creates visual distinction from body text without adding a third font.

rules.name: The Text-Balance Rule
rules.body: Headings use style={{ textWrap: "balance" }} to prevent orphaned words on narrow screens.

dos: Do use bronze sparingly — it is the only accent, and its scarcity gives it weight.
Do use textWrap: "balance" on all headings to prevent orphaned words.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — the Reveal component and .reveal CSS class both handle this.
Do use tabular-nums on any numeric display (countdown, counters) for stable digit widths.
Do keep split sections at 65/35 — this ratio creates asymmetric visual interest without feeling unbalanced.
donts: Don't add box-shadows. The system is flat; depth comes from images and typography weight.
Don't use navy for anything other than focus-visible outlines.
Don't use more than one accent color on a screen. Bronze is it.
Don't add decorative borders, dividers, or ornamental elements beyond the documented section decorations and the structural wayfinding hairlines. Let whitespace do the work.
Don't use rounded-lg or larger radius — the system's corner language is subtle (4px).
Don't animate with transforms beyond the established 8px translateY reveal pattern and the documented FAQ accordion exception.
